센서 종류와 샘플링 속도는 
7. Attribute Information:

1. Pressure sensors (PS1-6): 100 Hz, 6000 attributes per sensor
2. Motor power sensor (EPS1): 100 Hz, 6000 attributes per sensor
3. Volume flow sensors (FS1/2): 10 Hz, 600 attributes per sensor
4. Temperature sensors (TS1-4): 1 Hz, 60 attributes per sensor
5. Vibration sensor (VS1): 1 Hz, 60 attributes per sensor
6. Efficiency factor (SE): 1 Hz, 60 attributes per sensor
7. Virtual cooling efficiency sensor (CE): 1 Hz, 60 attributes per sensor
8. Virtual cooling power sensor (CP): 1 Hz, 60 attributes per sensor

PS1~PS6	압력	    100 Hz	6000
EPS1	모터 전력	100 Hz	6000
FS1~FS2	유량	    10 Hz	600
TS1~TS4	온도	    1 Hz	60
VS1	    진동	    1 Hz	60
SE	    효율 계수	1 Hz	60
CE	    냉각 효율    1 Hz	60
CP	    냉각 출력	1 Hz	60
